phaseA.result: Fast CI restored; timing breakdown and isolation audit recorded. No browser coverage removed or skipped.

phaseB.warmResult: 56/56 passed; cache hit; browser-tests job about 48s; full workflow about 67s.

phaseB.rca: The first experiment exposed a pre-existing viewer-live-refresh synchronization race; the test now waits for semantic refresh completion instead of assuming an updated table means the whole refresh finished.

contextArchitecture.result: Fresh-chat HOT context is bounded and preserved history is discoverable. Repository self-maintenance guards now enforce the structure during future changes.
